column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reads the suffix as “for them,” and כַּחֲבַצָּלֶת (“crocus”) as “the rose.”
Close to the Hebrew; “splendor” is rendered “excellence… excellency.”
Close to the Hebrew; “slack… stumbling” is rendered “weak… feeble.”
Close to the Hebrew; “hasty of heart” is rendered “fearful-hearted,” and “deliver” “save.”
Close to the Hebrew; “herbage” is rendered “grass,” and “papyrus” “rushes.”
NKJV renders the obscure “it [shall be] for them, one who walks the way” as “it shall be for others. Whoever walks the road, although a fool.”
Close to the Hebrew; “violent one of living creatures” is rendered “ravenous beast.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a shout of joy” is rendered “singing,” and “overtake” “obtain.”
